This matter is taken up through Hybrid mode.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for the Opposite Party- State.
3.

The present application has been filed under Section 482 of BNSS, 2023 by the Petitioners seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Buguda P.S. Case No.213 of 2007, corresponding to G.R.
Case No.530 of 2007, pending in the court of learned J.M.F.C., Buguda, for alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 451, 342, 376(2), 511, 323, 34 of IPC.
4.
It is stated by learned counsel for the Petitioners that as per the FIR allegation, one Nila Swain is the principal accused against whom the allegation is commission of rape.
He further contended that the present Petitioners are innocent persons, who have been falsely implicated in the present case.
He further contended that as per the FIR allegation, so far the present Petitioners are concerned, the only allegation is that they have been abused and assaulted the mother of the Victim/Informant.
He further contended that the mother of the Victim/Informant has not sustained any injury.
Learned counsel for the Petitioners further contended that the Petitioners do not have any criminal antecedents.

In course of his argument, learned counsel for the Petitioners contended that the ) Nari @ Narendra Swain vs State Of Odisha ..... Opposite Party on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170812974/
1 principal accused Nila Swain, who has been arrested in the meantime and released on bail by the trial Court.

sentences.text: 5. Considering the nature of allegation, gravity of offence and the facts and circumstances of the case, I am not inclined to grant pre-arrest bail to the Petitioners.

However, it is directed that in the event the Petitioners surrender before the Court in seisin over the matter within a period of four weeks from today and move an application for bail, the Court in seisin over the matter shall release them on bail in connection with the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as it may deem just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, but subject to verification of criminal antecedent of the Petitioners.
In the event, the Petitioners are having any criminal antecedent, then this order stands automatically revoked.
Accordingly, the ABLAPL is disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
(Aditya Kumar Mohapatra) Judge S.K. Rout Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Page 3 of 3.
